deck.audience: Technology executives and network infrastructure leaders

brief.title: Cloudflare Radar 2024 Year in Review
brief.one_liner: A data-driven analysis of global Internet traffic, adoption trends, connectivity disruptions, and security threats observed through Cloudflare's network in 2024.
brief.goal: Present the most significant Internet trends from 2024, including traffic growth, technology adoption shifts, connectivity challenges, and the evolving security landscape, to inform strategic planning for network and security leaders.

slides.title: Cloudflare Radar 2024 Year in Review
slides.objective: Title slide introducing the report scope: Internet patterns and trends observed through Cloudflare's global network during 2024.

slides.title: 17% Global Traffic Growth and Starlink's 3.3x Surge
slides.objective: Present overall Internet traffic growth of 17% and highlight SpaceX Starlink's 3.3x traffic increase as satellite connectivity expands to underserved regions.

slides.title: Google Leads Top 10 Services as Generative AI Rises
slides.objective: Show the top 10 most popular Internet services ranking with Google at #1, and discuss the continued meteoric rise of generative AI throughout 2024.

slides.title: Post-Quantum Encryption Jumps from 2% to 13% of TLS 1.3
slides.objective: Illustrate the dramatic adoption curve of post-quantum encryption following Chrome 124's default enablement, and cover HTTP/3 adoption at 21% and Go as the top API client language.

slides.title: 225 Major Disruptions: Government Shutdowns Lead Outage Causes
slides.objective: Analyze the 225 observed Internet disruptions by cause, highlighting government-directed shutdowns as the leading cause, followed by cable cuts (41) and power outages (16).

slides.title: 6.5% of Traffic Mitigated: Persistent Threats and Bot Concentration
slides.objective: Present security findings including 6.5% traffic mitigation rate, Gambling/Games as most attacked sector, Log4j's continued exploitation, and email security metrics (4.3% malicious emails).

slides.title: Five Takeaways Shaping the 2025 Internet Outlook
slides.objective: Summarize the five key findings: traffic growth trajectory, post-quantum encryption momentum, connectivity fragility from government actions, persistent security threats, and the evolving developer ecosystem.
